how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DVC Expert Finance (For SAP) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DVC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DVC Expert Finance (For SAP) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the DVC Expert Finance (For SAP) recruitment is 27 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Graduates with Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI or CMA from ICMAI, possessing 30 years of professional experience in Finance with at least 10 years in SAP/ERP implementation.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Expert Finance (For SAP) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,75,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Expert Finance (For SAP) post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the Expert Finance (For SAP) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official DVC website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the experience required for the Expert Finance (For SAP) role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 30 years of professional experience in Finance roles is required, with at least 10 years specifically in handling or implementing SAP/ERP systems, preferably in the power sector.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Damodar Valley Corporation?
faq.answer: The official website of Damodar Valley Corporation is https://www.dvc.gov.in.
